entities.name: Shanid
entities.description: Human knight and knight-ambassador of New Argive, paranoid and ruthless in hunting Phyrexian sleeper agents in the Balduvian Steppe.

entities.name: Stenn
entities.description: Man who dispatched Shanid to uncover Phyrexian sleeper agents.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: The homeland Shanid serves as knight-ambassador.

entities.name: Balduvian Steppe
entities.description: Region where Shanid searches for Phyrexian sleeper agents.

events.summary: Stenn dispatches Shanid to uncover Phyrexian sleeper agents in the Balduvian Steppe; Shanid leaves a trail of burned villages.
events.quote: has left a trail of burned villages behind him

relations.note: Shanid is dispatched by Stenn, the man he answers to.
relations.quote: Dispatched by Stenn to uncover signs of Phyrexian sleeper agents
